title: CT-VDETR: Semi-supervised 3D Trauma Detection in Computed Tomography (CT) scans using Dense Vertex Relative Position Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2603.12514v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate detection and localization of traumatic injuries in abdominal CT remain challenging because voxel-level annotations are limited and expensive to obtain. We present a label-efficient framework for 3D abdominal trauma detection that combines self-supervised pretraining with semi-supervised transformer-based detection. First, we use Masked Image Modeling (MIM) on 1,098 CT volumes to pretrain a 3D U-Net encoder for anatomical representation learning. Next, we adapt V-DETR to dense volumetric CT through a feature adapter that converts the encoder feature grid into a compact token sequence for transformer decoding. The pretrained encoder is then integrated with V-DETR and 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE) to improve the localization of irregularly shaped injuries. Finally, semi-supervised teacher-student consistency regularization leverages 2,000 additional unlabeled volumes during detector training. To the best

translated_title: CT-VDETR：基于密集顶点相对位置编码的计算机断层扫描（CT）半监督三维创伤检测
translated_abstract: 在腹部CT中准确检测和定位创伤性损伤仍然具有挑战性，因为体素级标注数量有限且获取成本高昂。我们提出了一种标签高效的三维腹部创伤检测框架，该框架将自监督预训练与基于Transformer的半监督检测相结合。首先，我们在1,098个CT体积上使用掩码图像建模（MIM）预训练一个3D U-Net编码器，用于解剖学表征学习。接下来，我们通过一个特征适配器将V-DETR适配到密集体积CT数据，该适配器将编码器特征网格转换为紧凑的token序列以供Transformer解码。随后，我们将预训练的编码器与V-DETR以及3D顶点相对位置编码（3DV-RPE）集成，以改善不规则形状损伤的定位效果。最后，半监督的师生一致性正则化在检测器训练过程中利用了额外的2,000个未标注CT体积。（注：原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CT-VDETR框架，通过掩码图像建模自监督预训练、3D顶点相对位置编码（3DV-RPE）以及半监督师生一致性正则化，实现了仅需少量标注数据的高效三维腹部创伤检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CT-VDETR, a label-efficient framework for 3D abdominal trauma detection that combines self-supervised masked image modeling pretraining, 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE), and semi-supervised teacher-student consistency regularization to accurately localize irregularly shaped injuries with limited voxel-level annotations.
